task: Finalize the Northbank Permit Center notices for email recipients, arriving visitors, and telephone callers.
source_facts: Northbank Permit Center and all notice details are synthetic. On February 12, 2033, from 10:00 to 12:00, the center's permit desk operates in Room B instead of its usual lobby position while the lobby counter is repaired. Before 10:00 and from 12:00 onward, the desk uses its usual lobby position. Existing appointments remain valid at their original times, and no rebooking is required because of the move. The service being provided does not change. Room B is inside the same building, and visitors should follow the Room B signs rather than leave for another location. The accessibility assistance number for this move is 555-0148. That number is for assistance with reaching the temporary desk; it does not create or change appointments. Independent reader journeys: Appointment email is sent to people with bookings, Entrance poster is printed by itself at the building entrance, and Telephone response is read verbatim to callers who may not have seen either written notice. Each channel must carry the move date, temporary hours, Room B destination, appointment validity, and accessibility number. A caller should not be referred to a poster to obtain the time window, and an arriving visitor should not need to retrieve an email. The poster's heading and body serve a single posted notice. In the current Telephone response, the consecutive sentences saying no replacement booking is needed and that no new appointment is needed express the same instruction without adding information.

# Northbank Permit Center temporary desk notices

## Appointment email

Subject: Temporary permit desk location on February 12, 2033

Your permit appointment remains valid at its original time. On February 12, 2033, from 10:00 to 12:00, the permit desk will operate in Room B while the usual lobby counter is repaired. The desk will provide the same service during the move.

Room B is inside the same building. Follow the Room B signs when you arrive during the temporary period; you do not need to travel to another location. Before 10:00 and from 12:00 onward, use the usual lobby desk position.

You do not need to rebook because of this temporary move. If you need accessibility assistance reaching the temporary desk, call 555-0148. That number is for assistance with reaching the desk, rather than for creating or changing an appointment.

## Entrance poster

### Permit desk temporarily in Room B

On February 12, 2033, from 10:00 to 12:00, please use the permit desk in Room B. The lobby counter is being repaired during this period, and permit service is being provided at the temporary desk.

Room B is in this building. Follow the Room B signs instead of leaving for another site. If you arrive before 10:00 or from 12:00 onward, the permit desk is at its usual lobby position.

Existing appointments remain valid at their original times. No rebooking is required because of the desk move. For accessibility assistance reaching Room B, call 555-0148. This assistance number does not create or change appointments.

## Telephone response

On February 12, 2033, from 10:00 to 12:00, the Northbank Permit Center desk will be in Room B while the lobby counter is repaired. Room B is inside the same building, so follow the Room B signs when you arrive during those hours. The permit service itself is unchanged.

Your existing appointment remains valid at its original time. You do not need to make a replacement booking because of the move. There is no need to book a new appointment because the desk has moved.

Before 10:00 and from 12:00 onward, use the usual lobby desk position. If you need accessibility assistance reaching the temporary desk, call 555-0148. The assistance number helps with reaching the desk; it does not create or change appointments.
